title: Learn baseline sensitivity, then test it on a held-out meeting

weeks.input: Ablation update with no baseline on the main path.
weeks.recorded_advisor_behavior: Advisor asked to see the strongest baseline before discussing the ablation.

weeks.input: New result with the baseline available only in backup.
weeks.recorded_advisor_behavior: Advisor again asked whether the comparison used the strongest baseline.
weeks.expected_profile_signal: second observation; confidence remains below high

weeks.input: Replication update with several comparator choices.
weeks.recorded_advisor_behavior: Advisor explicitly said to put the strongest baseline on the main path in future meetings.
weeks.expected_profile_signal: explicit_feedback; high confidence is now permitted

weeks.input: A new result includes a strongest baseline, two weaker comparators, and implementation detail.
expected_behavior: Place the strongest baseline on the main path.
Cite M01, M02, and M03 as profile evidence.
Do not use the held-out meeting as evidence before generating its package.
Keep weaker comparators or implementation detail in backup unless decision-relevant.

prohibited_behavior: Claim holdout success before recorded M04 feedback exists.
Alter project facts to fit the learned preference.
